TransactionSecurityPolicy.customEmailContent:
Salesforce Security Alert – Potential Session Hijacking Detected


Salesforce Threat Detection has identified a high-risk change in the characteristics of an active user session that may indicate potential session hijacking.


Policy: {{policy.MasterLabel}}

Organization ID: {{policy.OrganizationId}}

User: {{event.Username}}

Event Date: {{event.EventDate}}

Risk Score: {{event.Score}}


Previous IP: {{event.PreviousIp}}

Current IP: {{event.CurrentIp}}


Previous Platform: {{event.PreviousPlatform}}

Current Platform: {{event.CurrentPlatform}}


Previous User Agent: {{event.PreviousUserAgent}}

Current User Agent: {{event.CurrentUserAgent}}


This alert indicates that significant differences were detected within the same Salesforce session.


No action has been automatically blocked.


Please review the activity and confirm whether the session is legitimate.

Salesforce Security Monitoring
TransactionSecurityPolicy.description: Monitors high-risk session hijacking events detected by Salesforce Threat Detection. The policy sends a security alert when significant changes in browser fingerprint characteristics indicate that the same Salesforce session may be used from multiple environments.
TransactionSecurityPolicy.masterLabel: TSP Session Hijacking High Risk Alert
